## ToggleGroup.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `multiple` :: Lets any number of items be on, instead of at most one.
- `value` :: The pressed item values: a string when single (empty when none), a string array when `multiple`. Bindable.
- `onValueChange` :: Called with the new value whenever the selection changes.
- `variant` :: The visual style of every item.
- `size` :: The control height and text scale of every item.
- `textSize` :: The text scale of every item, independent of the control height. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `textColor` :: The text colour of every item. Defaults to `text-inverse` on dark variants, `text-primary` on light ones.
- `shape` :: The corner shape of every item.
- `orientation` :: The direction items run in, and which arrow keys move focus.
- `attached` :: Joins the items into one segmented control. When false they sit apart with a small gap.
- `disabled` :: Disables every item.
- `label` :: The accessible name of the group.
- `children` :: The `ToggleGroupItem` children.

## ToggleGroupItem.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `value` :: The value this item contributes to the group's `value` while it is on.
- `icon` :: An icon drawn before the label. With no label, set `aria-label`.
- `children` :: The label. Omit it for an icon-only item.

## toggle-group.ts

### `interface ToggleGroupState`

What a ToggleGroup shares with its items.

- `textSize` :: The text scale, when the group sets one.
- `textColor` :: The text colour, when the group sets one.
- `isPressed` :: Whether the item with this value is currently on.
- `toggle` :: Flip the item with this value, honouring `type`.
